Ultra Raises $50M to Put AI Packing Robots on More Warehouse Floors. Most robotics startups build for a future that sits five to 10 years away, and warehouses cannot use a future. Brooklyn’s Ultra took the opposite route, shipping a robot that goes from crate to working in under a day. CEO Jon Miller Schwartz explains what makes robotics a different game from software, and how a fresh $50M, bringing total funding to $62M, will put hundreds more robots to work on warehouse floors.
